evidence_kind: Matching PE/PDB static instruction evidence; no original runtime or device geometry observation.

source_geometry.priority: Actual map Points, then nonempty ThingData.Points, then nonzero ThingData.Size, then actual primary.GetDrawBounds; only absent primary falls back to the native minimal rectangle.
source_geometry.native_size_default: ThingData constructor RVA0xeb72f writes zero qword at full+0x174, clearing both Size coordinates after base-definition assignment. Empty authored Size is not a guessed GUI extent.
source_geometry.primary_call: RVA0x2dcd48 calls actual primary vtable+0xa8 with actual owner location, z0, unit world scale, then Polygon.FromRectangle; r12b is cleared on this branch so the later owner-scalar geometry pass is skipped.
source_geometry.later_transforms: Body squash precedes optional owner scaling; body flips and optional RotateGeometry use actual owner location. These are distinct from animation draw scale.
source_geometry.area: Thing.GetArea RVA0x2c6e0 returns cached mRectangle at Thing+0x98. SetupGeometry stores Polygon.AABB into this field after its transforms.

constant_bounds.atlas: Calls EnsureTextureAtlasEntry; reads actual atlas rectangle/origin and atlas X/Y scale. Missing atlas returns zero rectangle, never a synthetic full-screen sprite.
constant_bounds.scale_order: RVA0x2b2cf3..0x2b2d01: atlas scale multiplied by GetDrawScale(true), then actual GetDrawScaleVector. Shared native scale helper formulas and actual owner scalar/axis state apply.
constant_bounds.integer_order: RVA0x2b2d21..0x2b2d50 independently truncates float(drawLocation-origin*scale) to signed32 x/y, and float(atlasWidth/Height)*scale to signed32 width/height. Do not infer x/y by centering already-truncated dimensions.
constant_bounds.rotated_branch: RVA0x2b2dba..0x2b2e1d checks own angle/angle helper and maintained owner angle/helper. It conservatively pads to a square rather than simply rotating the unpadded atlas rectangle.
constant_bounds.draw_location: Animation.GetDrawLocation RVA0x297d60 applies actual source offsets/shifts, shake and owner scalar; primary-derived SetupGeometry supplies zero z.
constant_bounds.owner_scalar_order: GetScale RVA0x298c12 multiplies the current own scalar by attached Body.mScale, then RVA0x298c28 multiplies the owner helper. Do not precombine those owner factors when the own scalar is nonunit; float association is observable.

rectangle_polygon.numeric_order: First bottom-left y uses float(y)+float(height); other corner sums use signed32 integer additions before float conversion. Preserve this distinction when admitting large coordinates.
rectangle_polygon.aabb: Min x/y are rounded by the native roundf import then truncated to signed32; dimensions are abs(float(max-min)) truncated to signed32.

implementation_domain: Actual source-bound screen World Thing with live matching primary registry lifetime and no MapThing geometry.
One-frame nonmovie GUI Constant primary with retained full atlas rectangle/origin, unit parallax and positive scalar/axis extents.
Source scalar/axis animation helpers and live owner scalar/axis fractions are consumed; no extra body scale is applied after the primary rectangle.

Unsupported source Points/Size, nonzero original Thing.Offset, positive extent adjustments, body flips/rotation, angle padding, animated shifts, attached-text scalar and alternate primary types reject when interaction geometry is requested. Noninteractive source Things keep their deferred limitation without a fabricated rectangle.
Integer conversion/addition overflow and nonfinite values reject explicitly rather than reproducing native indefinite/wrapped geometry.
limits: Interaction geometry is requested from the current portable source/component state; the exact native geometry dirty-update/ECS scheduling phase remains unproven.
This contract establishes integer construction within the admitted domain, not full native material rendering or physical-device hit-test equivalence.
